commentary.text: 90+7' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+4' Neat passing move from Celta Vigo in order to create new attacking opportunities.
90+2' The game is interrupted. One of the players from Celta Vigo is cautioned for aggressive play.
90' 6 additional min. will be played.
88' Jonathan Bamba (Celta Vigo) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Jose Luis Munuera Montero had an easy-decision to make.
87' Claudio Giraldez has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Pablo Duran (Celta Vigo) replacing Iago Aspas.
85' Valencia can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
84' Substitution. Alberto Mari (Valencia) replaces Rafa Mir.
83' Valencia have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
82' Valencia quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
82' Rafa Mir (Valencia) connects with a cross from out wide in the six-yard box, but only plants his header onto the right post.
80' A player from Celta Vigo commits a rough challenge. Jose Luis Munuera Montero blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
78' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Damian Rodriguez (Celta Vigo) was quite harsh and Jose Luis Munuera Montero didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
77' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Dani Gomez (Valencia) is coming onto the pitch as Hugo Duro cannot continue after picking up an injury.
77' Substitution. Thierry Correia did his best and is replaced by Dimitri Foulquier (Valencia).
77' Here is a change. Diego Lopez is going off and Ruben Baraja gives the last tactical orders to Martin Tejon (Valencia).
76' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Valencia.
75' Here comes a substitution. Javier Rodriguez is given a rest as he is replaced by Carl Starfelt (Celta Vigo).
74' Valencia control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
72' Jose Luis Munuera Montero blows his whistle and it's Andre Almeida (Valencia) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
70' The attendance for today's match is 23519.

69' What a poor attempt! Luis Rioja (Valencia) drives another shot towards goal - this time from further out, but it couldn't have been worse if he had shot blindfolded. The ball goes yards wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Celta Vigo will have a goal kick.
68' Fran Beltran (Celta Vigo) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
67' Fran Beltran (Celta Vigo) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
66' Claudio Giraldez prepares a substitution. Anastasios Douvikas is replaced by Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo).
65' Williot Swedberg comes off the pitch to be replaced by Jonathan Bamba (Celta Vigo).
64' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Valencia.
61' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Luis Rioja (Valencia) will replace Javi Guerra.

60' 3 - 1 Fran Beltran (Celta Vigo) gets to the ball on the edge of the box and fires in a first-time shot without any hesitation. The strike is excellent and goes straight into the top right corner. He couldn't have done it any better. 3:1.
60' Celta Vigo earn a corner.
59' Williot Swedberg (Celta Vigo) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
56' Celta Vigo take a short corner kick.

56' Williot Swedberg (Celta Vigo) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly towards the roof of the net, but Giorgi Mamardashvili is well positioned to make a comfortable save. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Celta Vigo.
53' Sergio Carreira (Celta Vigo) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Jose Luis Munuera Montero blows for a foul.
53' Anastasios Douvikas (Celta Vigo) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
52' The game is interrupted now, Anastasios Douvikas (Celta Vigo) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.

50' The corner from Damian Rodriguez evades the keeper, but Carlos Dominguez (Celta Vigo) can't keep his close-range header down and fires it just over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Valencia will have a goal kick.
50' Damian Rodriguez (Celta Vigo) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
49' Sergio Carreira (Celta Vigo) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked. The ball is out of play and Celta Vigo manage to earn a corner.
48' One of the players from Valencia times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Oscar Mingueza is replaced by Sergio Carreira (Celta Vigo).
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+6' Jose Luis Munuera Montero has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.

45+5' Giorgi Mamardashvili anticipates the direction of the penalty by Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo). He attempted to put the ball into the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper was there in time to deny him.
45+4' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
45+4' Referee Jose Luis Munuera Montero is happy with his original decision after the VAR review. It’s a PENALTY to Celta Vigo!
45+3' Hang on! It might not be a penalty for Celta Vigo as the ref now wants to review using VAR. This hopefully won't take too long.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle, a clear handball by Hugo Duro (Valencia). PENALTY! A huge scoring opportunity for Celta Vigo.
45+2' Cristhian Mosquera (Valencia) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Jose Luis Munuera Montero saw the whole situation.
45' We will have 5 min. of added time.
44' Diego Lopez (Valencia) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
44' Celta Vigo are ruled offside.
43' A cross into the box finds the head of Hugo Duro (Valencia) who steers it goalwards, but Ivan Villar manages to pull off a decent save to thwart him.
42' The corner is swung in but Valencia can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
42' The Valencia players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
41' Pepelu (Valencia) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
40' Jesus Vazquez (Valencia) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The linesman signals a throw-in for Valencia.
39' Fran Beltran (Celta Vigo) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Jose Luis Munuera Montero blows for a foul.
38' A quickly taken corner by Celta Vigo.
38' A long ball forward to Carlos Dominguez (Celta Vigo) is intercepted. Celta Vigo force their opponents to concede a corner.
34' 6:3 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams. Shots on target – 3:3.
31' The Valencia players are exchanging some short passes.
28' 2 - 1 Goal! Oscar Mingueza tees up Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) on the edge of the box and he fires the ball into the bottom left corner. 2:1.

26' A brilliant individual effort! Williot Swedberg (Celta Vigo) tricks his way past challenges into the box and drags his shot narrowly wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Valencia.
25' Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) has tested the patience of referee Jose Luis Munuera Montero and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
25' Celta Vigo enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
23' 1 - 1 What a hit! Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) shows good composure inside the box to fire a first-time shot into the top of the net. 1:1.
20' Dangerous play by Thierry Correia (Valencia). Jose Luis Munuera Montero blows his whistle for a foul.

19' Thierry Correia (Valencia) bursts into the box after a fine solo run. He looks up and tries to rifle a shot into the middle of the goal, but Ivan Villar makes a great save to deny him his moment of glory.
18' Jose Luis Munuera Montero sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands!
15' The Valencia players halt their celebrations as referee Jose Luis Munuera Montero makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
14' 0 - 1 It's a goal! Diego Lopez (Valencia) bursts into the box to get on the end of a whipped in cross from Rafa Mir and scores magnificently from close range into the middle of the goal. 0:1.
14' Valencia get a corner.

13' Rafa Mir (Valencia) was all set to receive a beautiful pass into a promising position. However, one of the defenders makes a timely clearance. The linesman makes the right call and Valencia will have a corner.
12' Hugo Alvarez (Celta Vigo) unleashes a close-range volley towards the middle of the goal, but his effort is thwarted by the keeper, and the score remains unchanged.
8' Pepelu (Valencia) sends the free kick into the box, but Ivan Villar leaps to intercept it.
8' Jose Luis Munuera Montero interrupts the game. One of the players from Celta Vigo won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.
3' Celta Vigo seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
1' Jesus Vazquez (Valencia) was too forceful with his tackle and Jose Luis Munuera Montero interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
